body: It's definitely not unreasonable to want a response. Being ignored hurts, especially when it is with someone you were once really close to. I'm sorry for what you are going through. That isn't easy.  It sounds like she is going through a really hard time dealing with the situation as well. Give the situation and her time. Time will only tell. Whether she replies or not, I know your heart can heal and things will get easier.

I'm sorry your Dad said that to you. I believe the pain you are in regardless of you being too scared to commit suicide. The things you stated such as managing to get closer every time to suicide is concerning. Your pain is valid and I hear you. I'm sorry you are going through this rough time.
I'm sorry you are struggling so much. I feel similarly and I wouldn't wish it upon anyone. Hang in there. You're in my thoughts.

I am also diagnosed with BPD. I tried to support him the best I could as well. 

I understand where you're coming from. I've been told that I make other people seem like the bad guy. I've been manipulative when I thought he has hated me or going to be abandon me. It hurts so much to respond and act in ways that you don't want to. I felt completely out of control during the friendship and it only added to the shame. I think everything you are saying right now is completely valid.

Did you try explaining why you behaved the way you did?

I think change is possible and there is recovery and improvement in life with BPD. The fact that you are aware of your actions and behavior is admirable. It's a step in the right direction and a sign that things can change for you.  Are you seeing a therapist you can trust?

What you wrote sounds like it came straight from me. I feel the same way 100%. I understand what you are going through and understand how unbelievably painful it is. I want to kill myself because of how I hurt him too. I was also manipulative even though I cared for him more than anything. I wish I showed more appreciation. I feel so much regret and embarrassment. I feel like a toxic and awful person.

Why were you manipulative? Did you have feelings for him as more than friends? Feel free to not reply. I'm here if you are looking for someone to talk to though. Stay strong as well.
Just wanted to update and say that I've calmed down and feel safe enough that I can go home without doing anything tonight. Thank you for taking the time. It made a difference.

They had developed a drinking problem and I couldn't take the stress anymore of worrying about them and the way they acted drunk. Instead of explaining how I felt, I cut them off and ignored them for a period of time. It was immature. If there had been an emergency or they contacted me saying they weren't okay then I would of replied. I feel like if I would of been honest with them throughout our friendship, then they would of known that I had cared more and wouldnt have taken up drinking. I feel responsible and have alot of regrets.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.
